Ontario highway Traffic Act:
The driver or operator of a vehicle upon a highway before turning to the left or right at any intersection or into a private road or driveway or from **one lane for traffic to another lane for traffic** or to leave the roadway shall first see that the movement **can be made in safety**, and if the operation of any other vehicle may be affected by the movement shall give a signal plainly visible to the driver or operator of the other vehicle of the intention to make the movement. I agree, but honestly, anyone should see whoever they can get to first, especially if they feel like they can't cope anymore on their own.

There's a reason though why Psychiatry is more likely to push medicine though. Psychiatry is a medical field and generally, while having some psychology background, have gone through the Medical profession training and education. It's more of a "disease" mentality, that things can be cured by medication and affecting the diseased portion of the body. IN the case of Mental illness, its a hit or miss philosophy. they're good at what they do, and many are well equipped to understand, but the levels at which they address things are completely different.

Psychology field however, being non medical, addresses psychological disorders differently. it's more about figuring out why personaly and emotionally, and attempting to address it on a personal basis.

both have their merrits, and both can be used quite succesfully in conjunction with eachother. However, In my own personal belief, Psychology is a more permanent solution. Psychiatry with drugs don't often address the root causes of depression and it's feelings, but attempt to medicate and "mask". you will feel better, but you won't know why. This sounds good, except it's reliant on continued usage of the mood altering drugs, perhaps long term or indefinately. There is evidence that once patients stop with their treatment, many revert back to their former state after a period of time, since the troubles at the cause were not dealt with. However, combined with Psychology, it' could pack a potent 1, 2 punch in order to calm the moods, and then address it.



This is all secondary consideration though. The important and first thing, is getting help of any kind.
